source.title: GEOS Aerosols (2025)
source.credit: NASA's Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO) and NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio (SVS)
limitations: Model output (GEOS-FP replay), not an observation.
One moment only (19 Aug 2025 20:00 UTC): no change over time, so each region plays a steady rhythm.
Plumes are a rendering of modelled aerosol; the numbers describe the drawn picture, not air quality or amounts.
Pixels are not square (16:9 world map): 0.094 degrees per pixel east-west, 0.083 north-south.

legend.quantity: Aerosol type (colour of the plumes), GEOS-FP model

regions.name: Sulfate and sea-salt streaks near Vanuatu
regions.description: Open ocean east of New Caledonia, near Vanuatu, where green sulfate and blue sea-salt streaks run mostly the same way.

regions.name: Sea-salt cells in the southeast Pacific
regions.description: Open ocean in the southeast Pacific, where blue sea salt forms a honeycomb of small cells pointing every way.
